artworks.title: Study of a Figure from Behind
artworks.medium: graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing the back view of a person from the head down to about the feet. The person is positioned with their back facing the viewer, appearing to be leaning or reclining. The detailed facial features are not visible, as only the back of the head is shown, featuring short, smoothed-down hair. The clothing consists of a long, flowing garment with wide sleeves that extends toward the floor. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects being held. The sketch is drawn on a plain background on tan paper, with no additional details or patterns.

artworks.title: Study of a Figure from Behind [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite heightened with white on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image is a pencil and watercolor sketch on paper depicting two figures. Both figures are depicted in full length. The person on the left is kneeling with their head slightly bowed, with obscured facial features by shadowing, wearing a long draped garment and a head covering. The figure on the right is standing with an extended arm, with indistinct facial features and wearing a flowing garment. The background is a plain, natural-toned paper.

artworks.title: Study of Figures [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch on a beige paper background featuring two figures. Both figures are standing upright; the one on the left is slightly turned and appears to have one arm raised. The faces are drawn as oval shapes with no detailed features, and the hair is suggested with simple lines. The clothing on each figure is shown as long, flowing garments, indicated by a few vertical and diagonal lines suggesting drapery. The sketch is light and lacks any significant detailing or jewelry. The right side of the paper shows a subtle, jagged edge. The background is blank with no additional elements depicted.

artworks.title: Study for a Lunette
artworks.medium: graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image portrays a series of curving and slanting lines forming an arc-like shape encircling a reclining figure. The central figure is sketched with fluid lines suggesting a person reclining. On the right, fluid lines hint at another form with an upward-reaching flow, resembling a person in motion or a musical instrument. The scene is enclosed within a large arch shape, with textured, horizontal lines adding depth and background to the abstract composition.

artworks.title: Study for a Lunette
artworks.medium: graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an abstract scene featuring two figures positioned under a semi-circular arch. The central figure is seated, head slightly bent forward and supported by a hand. The other figure, standing beside, leans towards the seated figure. The background contains loosely sketched lines that might suggest drapery or environmental elements. The lines are simple and fluid, conveying motion and an intimate interaction between the two figures.

artworks.title: Studies for a Lunette
artworks.medium: black conté crayon on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a series of small compositions and figures. The full drawing consists of multiple rough sketches on a light brown paper. At the top, there are three separate semi-circular sketches depicting simplified figures interacting with each other. Below these, there is another small arch-shaped sketch showing two figures. On the lower right corner, a distinct sketch shows a single figure in a dress in a dynamic pose with arms extended and holding up the hem of the dress. The use of soft pencil lines with varying pressure gives the impression of an unfinished work, possibly studies for larger compositions. The paper has been left mostly untouched, with smudges suggesting movement while drawing.

artworks.title: Studies for a Lunette [recto]
artworks.medium: colored pencils and charcoal on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image depicts several semi-circular shapes arranged vertically on a muted brown background. These abstract shapes contain faintly sketched figures and forms resembling human silhouettes seated and interacting. The soft lines and subtle color shading suggest movement and depth within the compositions, evoking scenes of gatherings or conversations.

artworks.title: Studies for a Lunette [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite and purple pencil on tan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple sketched figures. The page is filled with lightly sketched outlines depicting human forms in various poses, some sitting, others standing. The lines are delicate, and the figures are rendered with minimal detail, primarily conveying posture and movement. Some areas of the drawing include overlapping arcs. In the bottom right corner, there are subtle hints of shading. The overall appearance suggests it is a preparatory sketch that could serve as the groundwork for a more detailed piece.

artworks.title: Figure Study
artworks.medium: graphite on tan laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a series of crisscrossing lines and indistinct shapes swirling within a circular frame, suggesting an abstract composition. The sketchy lines form an entangled figure resembling a person hunched over. Subtle, overlapping lines create a texture reminiscent of preliminary sketches or preparatory outlines in a drawing.

artworks.title: Figure Study
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a pencil sketch of a partially visible human figure. The visible part of the body is shown from around the shoulders to the knees, with the upper half of the body not clearly defined. The figure appears to be in a seated or reclining position, with arms and legs bent in a relaxed posture. The facial features are not distinctly drawn, and the hair is not clearly outlined. The clothing is suggested by lines and shade marks, giving the sketch an abstract and unfinished appearance. There are no jewelry or objects present, and the background is blank, emphasizing the sketched lines.

artworks.title: Figure Studies
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite heightened with white on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows fluid and expressive brushstrokes creating an abstract composition with a central figure. The shapes suggest a person with arms raised, cloaked in sweeping fabric. Blue and purple strokes surround the figure, resembling waves or flowing water. The wavy lines suggest a billowing gown. The artwork invites the viewer to imagine a dancer mid-performance, evoking the familiarity of a dance performance.

artworks.title: Study of Two Female Figures in Arched Border
artworks.medium: gouache and graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows an arched shape with lines and flowing forms on its surface. Two figures in long, flowing garments, holding up a rectangular panel with text in the center. The background features abstract patches of muted colors, and above, a rougher abstract form.

artworks.title: Study of Two Female Figures in Arched Border
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, graphite, and black conté crayon on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an arched architectural design with two figures on either side of a central plaque with abstract geometric symbols. Below the scene are sketches and measurements, indicating it is a design for a larger architectural artwork. The drawing seems to be an illustration for a mural or decorative element in a classical or historic setting.

artworks.title: Study for a Lunette
artworks.medium: gouache and graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a painting of abstract figures in white robes with a blue semicircular backdrop. The painting is composed of two groups of ambiguous figures. On the left side, a cluster of figures in flowing white robes appears to be in motion. The brushwork suggests unity or collective action among them. To the right, a single figure, draped in a white robe with a hint of red at the hem, stands apart. The background features an expansive blue arch. The simplicity of forms and color palette evokes a sense of classical antiquity and narrative depth. This is in the style of James McNeill Whistler.

artworks.title: Studies for Lunettes
artworks.medium: gouache, black conté crayon, and graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in an undefined landscape. The central composition features two figures; one is wearing a dark, textured garment, and the other is clad in a pale, flowing dress and holds a leafy branch or frond. These figures are positioned against a backdrop that suggests a landscape with indistinct elements like a dark, cloud-like form arching overhead. The surrounding area is depicted with soft washes and light sketching, indicating an open terrain with abstract hints of natural elements. In the upper right corner, there is a circular emblem or motif containing a simplified, stylized figure. The use of color is minimal, focusing on neutral hues and delicate lines.

artworks.title: Study for a Lunette
artworks.medium: oil and graphite on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows two figures engaged in interaction. One figure is crouched down, reaching towards the standing figure on the right. The crouched figure has reddish-brown hair and wears a light-colored garment. The standing figure has dark hair and wears a robe-like attire. Both figures extend their hands towards each other. The background features an outdoor setting with greenery, trees, and a sky with blue and white swirls.

artworks.title: Study for a Lunette
artworks.medium: gouache with pen and black ink and graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image depicts four figures in historical attire standing in a minimal setting. One person in a deep red robe interacts with a figure in white who extends a palm branch. Two other figures in blue and yellow garments stand nearby. The background features a half-moon shape. The style is reminiscent of John William Godward with Neoclassical influences. The colors are muted, and the figures' postures suggest interaction or ceremony, with focus on drapery and form.

artworks.title: Study for a Panel
artworks.medium: watercolor with red and black conté crayons on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image contains blurred shapes and lines in earthy tones such as browns and greens, creating an abstract composition. There is a silhouette of figures alongside shapes resembling fences or draped fabric.

artworks.title: Study for a Panel
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a full-body side view. The individual's head is slightly bowed as they appear to be looking down at an object they are holding. The person's facial features are softly depicted with minimal detail, and their hair is styled and colored deep red. They are wearing a long, flowing robe-like garment in a soft pink hue that reaches down to their feet. The background consists of a wash of watercolors in pale blues and beiges with abstract shapes and vertical forms, creating a serene atmosphere around the figure.

artworks.title: Study for a Panel
artworks.medium: watercolor with red and black conté crayons on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a painting of abstract forms with a blend of organic shapes and soft, muted colors. The painting has a rough, sketch-like quality with visible brushstrokes and a mix of earthy greens and browns layered over a lighter background. The composition suggests a landscape with possible foliage and earth tones, capturing a fleeting moment in nature with a suggested presence of trees or vegetation. The style is reminiscent of Edgar Degas, who was known for his use of soft lines and impressionistic approach to landscapes and figures.

artworks.title: Study for a Panel
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a side view of a person standing in a natural setting. The person is positioned with a slight bend forward, as if gazing downwards, and we only see them in profile. Facial features are minimally detailed, indicating a calm or neutral expression, and the person's hair is long and drawn back, partly covered by a rounded hat. This individual is clothed in a long, flowing garment of a muted orange color that drapes loosely to their feet. They appear to be holding a book or similar object in their hand. The background presents a stylized version of a natural scene, with loosely sketched trees and foliage in soft greens and browns, establishing an impression of a wooded or garden environment that frames the figure within a simple blue border.

artworks.title: Study for a Panel
artworks.medium: brown watercolor with red and black conté crayons on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a painting of two figures rendered in soft browns, beige, and red tones. One figure has faint wings and appears to be kneeling or bowing with an outstretched hand towards the second figure draped in a cloak or robe. The second figure's posture suggests it might be seated or leaning, creating a sense of interaction between the two. The background is subtly dark with a wash of deeper tones on the left side.

artworks.title: Study for a Lunette
artworks.medium: gouache and black conté crayon on greenish-tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image features two figures within an arched frame. The first person is seated on the ground, with dark hair and wearing a red garment. The second person is standing, with long red hair and wearing a white dress, extending an arm towards the seated figure. The background includes birch trees, orange leaves on the ground, rocks, and an ornate arch framing the scene.

artworks.title: Study for an Archway
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and graphite on tan laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This image features a semi-circular composition with a horizon placed roughly at the upper third section. Two figures clad in robes stand closest to us on the right side, one gesturing upwards, accompanied by some minimal vegetation nearby. Beyond them, several tall, slender trees rise vertically, their trunks emerging prominently against the horizontal lines that define the landscape. The horizon is composed of a slightly undulating line that indicates rolling hills or terrain in the distance. The style employs loose, sketch-like brushstrokes with a monochrome palette, relying heavily on shades of grey and black to create contrast and depth. The methodical lines of shading provide texture and suggest the presence of light and shadow across the scene.
